schema.name: commit_receipts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE commit_receipts (
                request_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                scope_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                body_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
                state TEXT NOT NULL,
                task_id TEXT,
                outcome TEXT,
                release_proven INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
            )

schema.name: receipt_bindings
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE receipt_bindings (request_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, task_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, archive_uri TEXT NOT NULL)

schema.name: queue_metadata
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE queue_metadata (
                queue_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                created_at INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now')),
                last_updated INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now'))
            )

schema.name: queue_messages
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE queue_messages (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                queue_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                data TEXT NOT NULL,
                timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
                processing_started_at INTEGER,
                created_at INTEGER DEFAULT (strftime('%s', 'now'))
            )
